name: scan-to-model
title_zh: 扫描照片图纸实测，拼成一栋能审的 Blender 建
tagline_zh: 手里只有一堆零碎证据——手机照片、激光点云、手绘平面、卷尺读数——它逼你逐条标出每个尺寸的出处，再拼成能打开。
tagline_en: You have scattered evidence — phone photos, point clouds, sketches, tape measurements. It forces you to tag where.
desc_en: Coordinate evidence based reconstruction from scans, photos, plans, and measurements into a reviewable Blender architectural model.
why_zh: 每个构件都挂着来源和置信度，冲突的尺寸会被摆到台面上让你裁决，而不是悄悄取平均。
why_en: Every element carries its source and confidence; conflicting dimensions get surfaced for you to arbitrate instead of being.
limit_zh: 本机要装 Blender 和 Python 环境；它只做建筑尺度（房间、墙体、楼层）。
limit_en: Needs Blender + Python locally; architectural scale only (rooms, walls, floors) — organic shapes like furniture or faces are out of scope; output.
title_en: Scans, photos, plans and measurements merged into one.
